title: Orb Booster
description: Adds an enchantment that multiplies your gained XP.

# Orb Booster
**Orb Booster** is an enchantment that increases XP gains. Whether you're mining blocks or killing mobs, this enchantment boosts the amount of experience you receive. Orb Booster blends seamlessly into vanilla gameplay while offering powerful utility for progression-focused players.

## Features
  
- **XP from Mining** – Break ores and gain more XP
  
- **XP from Mobs** – Kill mobs and gain more XP
  
- **Stackable Levels** – Higher levels = larger XP multipliers
